effects.note: TK-X206/X207 on synthetic sensor sessions (effects_session). The held-out set is effects_heldout(), a separate generator with its own seed, binaries, hosts, paths and timings, committed before the checks existed: the E20 pool has no effects section. A fault is found when the check flags it, missed when the check passed it, not checkable otherwise.

note: Synthetic Claude Code sessions replayed through the hook and tailer into a vault-on signer. Detection is per spliced fault call, by any of the fault's checks; not-checkable outcomes are counted apart, never as passes. held_live: the share of fault calls a live constraint held for approval; forged_flagged: the share of c5_line sessions whose forged prompt line TK-X208 flagged. development: pool v1, written blind but read while tuning TK-X205; held_out: pool v2, written blind and never used to change a check; unmapped: what of a pool the sessions don't replay. Model arms (a reviewer, real claude -p runs) are not part of this offline run.
